summary: The document outlines a hack to make modal popups and potentially other Ajax Toolkit functionalities work in Google Chrome by treating Safari 3 as a WebKit browser.
purpose: The purpose is to ensure compatibility of Ajax components, such as modal popups, with the Google Chrome browser by using a workaround that identifies Safari 3 as a WebKit browser.

workflows.name: Make Ajax functionality work in Chrome
steps: Identify if the browser is Safari 3 by checking for 'WebKit/' in the userAgent.
Parse the version from the userAgent and assign it to Sys.Browser.version.

system_behavior: The system identifies Safari 3 and potentially other WebKit-based browsers to apply a specific set of browser properties to ensure Ajax functionalities work correctly.
